topic.source_contract: Part 2A contaminated land, planning and remediation verification evidence

facts.guard: potential contamination is not a statutory determination
statutory contaminated land requires the legal risk test
guidance use is not completed remediation

facts.verification: lines of evidence against a verification plan
facts.guard: remediation proposal is not verified completion
advice is not planning permission or Part 2A clearance

scope_guards: Potentially contaminative history is not proof of significant contamination.
Planning remediation and Part 2A statutory determination are distinct routes.
A desk study, conceptual site model and intrusive investigation remain distinct evidence stages.
Remediation strategy, implementation and verification must not be merged.
Voluntary Environment Agency advice is not regulatory approval or planning permission.
Absence of a Part 2A entry is not proof that land is suitable for every proposed use.
Contamination evidence is not HMLR title, ownership, valuation or automatic refusal.
No score or promotion is written without exact site history, investigation, risk assessment, remediation, verification and planning evidence.
